subject.title: Enhancement: Developer experience quick wins from code analysis

question: Should the remaining work add summaries to `openclaw status`, rely on dedicated plugin diagnostics, and what visibility level should identify normal model-routed skill commands?
rationale: Current supported commands already provide detailed plugin diagnostics, while status has a deliberate fast-path boundary; the appropriate duplication, performance cost, and warning noise are product choices rather than mechanical fixes.

options.title: Focused status and trace
options.body: Add a bounded plugin-health summary to `status --all` and JSON, and emit a structured debug or trace event for model-routed skill invocation.

options.title: Dedicated diagnostics only
options.body: Keep plugin details in `plugins doctor` and `plugins inspect`, document that routing clearly, and add only the skill invocation trace signal.

options.title: Close remaining requests
options.body: Treat current dedicated diagnostics and skill-dispatch documentation as sufficient without adding new runtime output.

recommendation.title: Focused status and trace
recommendation.body: Add a bounded plugin-health summary to `status --all` and JSON, and emit a structured debug or trace event for model-routed skill invocation.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the prior product-routing review and are connected by history to both remaining decision surfaces.
